title: Annotatio III §.III: Prior year — assembled theologians tell the Papists none among them foster opinions alien to the Confession; consensus stands in the foundation
pass_a_gloss: IN THE PRIOR YEAR, to the Papists with whom there was to be colloquy, the assembled Theologians say: that there is not among them anyone who fosters erroneous Opinions alien to the Confession, and that there is Consensus in the foundation.
pass_b_english: In the prior year, the assembled theologians tell the Papists with whom they were to confer: none among them fosters erroneous opinions alien to the Confession, and they stand in consensus on the foundation.
source_text: ANNO PRIORI, Papistis, cum quibus erat colloquendum, dicunt Theologi congregati: Non esse inter se, qui erroneas foveant Opiniones, à Confessione alienas, Consensumque esse in fundamento.

lemmas.latin: erroneas foveant Opiniones, à Confessione alienas
lemmas.gloss: foster erroneous opinions alien to the Confession
and that consensus is in the foundation

notes: Hexades Annotatio III §.III densify §210; 1557 reply to Papists.
